items.title: Ford’s Sales and Revenue Are Down. The Automaker Isn’t Sweating It.
items.summary: Ford Motor’s  revenue fell in the second quarter amid declining U.S. sales.  The automaker is nonetheless upbeat about the auto industry.  The Dearborn, Mich., company on Tuesday raised its full-year profit forecast and said it is confident Americans would continue to buy pricey, big pickups and sport-utility vehicles that dominate its lineup.
